title.en: An Act Declaring December 8 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union, to Be Known as Agoo Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring December 8 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union, to Be Known as Agoo Day
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 8 tháng 12 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Agoo, Tỉnh La Union với tên gọi "Agoo Day"
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 8 ธันวาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในเทศบาล Agoo จังหวัด La Union ในชื่อ "Agoo Day"
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 8 Desember setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Kotamadya Agoo, Provinsi La Union dengan nama "Agoo Day"
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 8 Disember setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Perbandaran Agoo, Wilayah La Union dengan nama "Agoo Day"

text.en: Decembers of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union, in commemoration of its founding anniversary, to be known as "Agoo Day".
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
